analysis: Analysis 2: false positives by generating rule and pharmacologic class

definitions.over_call_ratio: n_flagged divided by n_confirmed in the same cell; null when the cell has no pharmacist-confirmed positive
definitions.n_false_positive: flagged by the labeller and not pharmacist-confirmed; ambiguous pairs count as false positives here
definitions.n_false_positive_excluding_ambiguous: flagged, and the pharmacist called it not a contradiction

data_agreement: Rule ids, dictionary class names and integer counts only. No clinical note text and no patient or admission identifier appears in this artifact; asserted in code before writing.
